title: Fit a sized container
summary: A responsive chart uses its parent container to decide its display size.
introduction: A responsive chart uses its parent container to decide its display size. Your task: Change the holder width and watch the chart resize.
learningObjectives: Change the holder width and watch the chart resize.
Explain the example for fit a sized container

blocks.text: A responsive chart uses its parent container to decide its display size. The parent needs a clear size when the aspect ratio is not maintained.
Use a browser project with Chart.js 4 installed. Each example creates its own canvas inside a sized holder. Package imports need your project build tool and do not run in this playground.

blocks.title: Fit a sized container

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.
`maintainAspectRatio: false` lets the Chart.js canvas use the explicit height of its parent holder.

blocks.text: The chart can resize with its dedicated holder while keeping the configured height.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not make the canvas its own sizing container. Use a relatively positioned parent.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the holder width and watch the chart resize.
